```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(highcharter)
hc_set_theme("hcrt", tooltip = list(valueDecimals = 2))
```

## Icons as markers

A scatter series can use the same SVG for its markers and its tooltip. Save
the [R icon](icons/r-project.svg) and [Python icon](icons/python.svg) in an
`icons/` directory alongside the HTML page. These brand icons come from
[Font Awesome Free 6.7.2](https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/tree/6.7.2/svgs/brands)
and are licensed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
The example uses simulated task times; the same approach works with other images.

```{r svg-markers}
r_icon <- "./icons/r-project.svg"
python_icon <- "./icons/python.svg"

highchart() |>
  hc_title(text = "Simulated task times") |>
  hc_xAxis(categories = c("Read", "Transform", "Plot")) |>
  hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Seconds")) |>
  hc_chart(type = "scatter") |>
  hc_add_series(
    name = "R",
    data = c(2, 4, 3),
    custom = list(icon = r_icon),
    marker = list(symbol = paste0("url(", r_icon, ")"), width = 20, height = 20)
  ) |>
  hc_add_series(
    name = "Python",
    data = c(3, 2, 4),
    custom = list(icon = python_icon),
    marker = list(
      symbol = paste0("url(", python_icon, ")"),
      width = 20,
      height = 20
    )
  ) |>
  hc_tooltip(
    useHTML = TRUE,
    pointFormat = paste0(
      "<img src='{series.options.custom.icon}' width='16' height='16' alt=''/> ",
      "{series.name}: <b>{point.y} s</b>"
    )
  )
```

## Count with pictograms

An item chart draws one symbol per unit. Here one icon represents one simulated
workshop registration. Set the marker on each point to distinguish the two groups.
The data and counts are illustrative.

```{r item-icons}
registrations <- list(
  list(name = "R", y = 24, marker = list(symbol = paste0("url(", r_icon, ")"))),
  list(
    name = "Python",
    y = 16,
    marker = list(symbol = paste0("url(", python_icon, ")"))
  )
)
highchart() |>
  hc_chart(type = "item") |>
  hc_title(text = "Simulated workshop registrations") |>
  hc_subtitle(text = "One icon = one registration") |>
  hc_add_series(
    data = registrations,
    name = "Registrations",
    showInLegend = TRUE,
    dataLabels = list(enabled = FALSE)
  ) |>
  hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "<b>{point.name}</b>: {point.y} registrations") |>
  hc_legend(labelFormat = "{name}: {y}")
```
